convention: Cost = inputTokens x cache-miss rate + cacheReadTokens x cache-hit rate + outputTokens x output rate. Cache-write tokens are NOT separately billed in this table: DeepSeek charges no separate cache-write fee, and for Kimi K3 the TTL-based cache-write fee cannot be attributed from usage records (no TTL is recorded), so Kimi costs here are slightly understated. Both arms of a comparison use the same table and the same model, so the savings percentage is unaffected by these conventions. Unknown models are never priced by guess: they land in the unpriced bucket and are reported, not costed.
